mode: reference-based animation atlas; followed by transparent slicing and layered assembly

prompts.eat:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production sprite atlas for a 12-frame chicken eating/pecking cycle, on genuine transparent RGBA.
Input images: 1 is the exact approved chicken identity/style at high resolution; 2 is its current normalized hungry neutral pose and canvas alignment; 3 and 4 are the same approved producing and ready states, STYLE references only. Match this exact round cream hen, salmon comb, soft brown outline, tiny golden feet, one dot eye, three tail feathers and simple scalloped wing. Do not redesign or use another chicken. Non-pixel flat softly shaded illustration, no added texture or details.
Composition: exactly FOUR columns and THREE rows, twelve evenly spaced equal cells in reading order, no cell borders, no labels, no text. Prefer canvas 1440 x 840, each cell 360 x 280. In each cell keep the torso/pelvis stationary, consistent identical chicken scale, about 180px torso width excluding tail. Neutral footprint must match image 2: near foot/toe ground point (180,230), far foot about (131,219); preserve the perspective height difference. Only the head/upper-body bend articulates; the two feet remain planted. Keep all artwork fully inside its cell with generous transparent gutter. View is the same left-facing oblique three-quarter view, slightly looking down, throughout all frames.
Animation key poses: frame 00 neutral attentive with beak slightly open, frame 01 upper body bends forward 10 degrees, frame 02 bends 25 degrees and beak points down, frame 03 bends 40 degrees, frame 04 deepest peck down with beak nearly touching an imaginary spot just in front-left of the planted feet, frame 05 small upward recoil with beak slightly open, frame 06 second distinct downward peck, frame 07 small upward recoil slightly higher, frame 08 third downward peck with tiny eye squint, frame 09 rises halfway, frame 10 nearly upright, frame 11 slightly less upright than neutral approaching frame 00. Show a real anatomical neck/head nod and change of body silhouette; not twelve copies of the same upright chicken. It has a fused round chick-like body, so bending upper chest is okay, but never turn it into a long-neck bird or rotate the entire animal including the feet.
All 12 frames must be distinct and smoothly ordered; last frame is the pose just BEFORE the first, not a duplicated first frame. One cycle at 12 fps.
Critical invariants: same head/body mass and colors every frame, same outline thickness, same wing and tail identity, SAME planted feet positions, no change of camera or zoom. No ground, no baked shadow at all, no feed or bowl, no seeds or crumbs, no egg, no fence, no UI, no decorations, no motion streaks, no backdrop, no checkerboard painted into the image. Actual transparent alpha.
prompts.walkLegRefinement:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: Image 1, an existing 4-column x 3-row walking sprite atlas. Image 2 is the exact approved neutral chicken for anatomy/style. The first draft lacks actual walking leg articulation. Correct only the leg animation and clean the transparent outside area. Preserve every chicken's head, torso, face, wing, comb, tail, palette and soft outline.
All 12 full chickens must remain in a 4x3 equal grid, no labels, actual transparent background, NO shadows. Keep the same sheet frame order and same consistent body size. Twelve different leg poses at evenly spaced phases. Do not redraw bodies into another character.
Make the tiny lower legs VISIBLE between belly and toes during the gait, about 12 pixels long at native 360x280 frame scale, with the same golden-yellow fill and brown outline as the feet. Some leg is tucked behind the rounded belly. There are exactly two legs and two feet, each toe-bearing and clearly attached. Raise the torso only 3 pixels to provide articulation space. Do NOT merely move both feet sideways, and do NOT bend the whole animal.
Imagine walking leftwards on a plane with near foot baseline y230 and far foot baseline y219. Native ground movement vector per cycle(-36,+18); image/pelvis stays stationary. Each stance foot travels backwards relative to stationary torso; swing foot lifts 8 pixels and advances, then lands. Clearly lift one foot entirely off the ground in frames 02,03,04 and the opposite foot in frames 08,09,10. Show its bent ankle and curled toes, separating it visibly from the planted foot.
Frame 00: NEAR foot extended forward-left, planted flat, FAR foot extended back-right, heel raised.
01: near foot pushing backward while far toes lift.
02: near foot flat, far foot airborne bent ankle moving forward.
03: near foot at mid-stance; far foot passes forward, highest lift, toes curved down.
04: near foot at rear stance; far foot reaching forward with toes spread but still airborne.
05: far foot just before landing forward-left; near heel raised at back.
06: FAR foot planted forward-left, NEAR foot at rear toe-off.
07: far foot pushes back, near foot lifts.
08: far foot flat, near foot airborne bent ankle forward.
09: far foot at mid-stance; near foot highest lift passing forward.
10: far foot at rear stance; near foot reaching forward airborne, toes open.
11: near foot just before landing into frame00; far heel up. Never duplicate frame00.
Ground motion must be produced by alternating articulated feet, not complete-image wobble/sliding. Root stays fixed. Keep subtle body weight changes only, NO flapping or blinking.
Remove ALL disconnected colored speckles outside the animal outlines. Exterior pixels must be alpha zero. Preserve crisp anti-aliased edges and the approved cream/brown/salmon colors. No floor, no drop shadow, no food, no UI, no lines, no checkerboard.
prompts.walkAlternateSupport:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the transparent 4 columns x 3 rows chicken sprite sheet provided as Image1. Image2 is the approved neutral chicken style.
The upper six frames are acceptable. The bottom SIX frames have a specific error: the same foot remains grounded throughout. Fix only the two legs/feet of the last SIX chickens. Preserve ALL heads, bodies, combs, wings, tails, spacing and sizes.
Identify the two feet by screen position: one is under the LEFT side of the belly (closer to the beak), the other under the RIGHT side of the belly (closer to the tail).
For frame06 (row2 col3), frame07 (row2 col4), frame08 (row3 col1), frame09 (row3 col2), and frame10 (row3 col3): the foot on the RIGHT SIDE OF THE IMAGE must be visibly FLAT AND PLANTED BELOW THE BELLY at its ground baseline. The foot on the LEFT SIDE OF THE IMAGE must be LIFTED IN THE AIR, BENT AT THE ANKLE, WITH CURLED TOES. This is the OPPOSITE of the top row where left foot is planted and right foot is lifted. Do not leave the LEFT image foot grounded in these five cells.
Specifically:
row2 col3: right foot leading forward and flat, left foot toe-off behind.
row2 col4: right foot planted, left foot lifted at bent ankle.
row3 col1: right foot planted, left foot clearly raised 8px above its baseline, swinging forward.
row3 col2: right foot planted mid-stance, left foot highest lift while passing.
row3 col3: right foot planted rear-stance, left foot reaches forward airborne.
row3 col4: left foot just before touchdown, right foot heel raised, approaching frame00.
You must visibly alternate support leg between first half and second half. A natural chicken march, no whole-body sliding.
Exactly 12 complete animals in the same FOUR columns THREE rows. No shadows, no ground, no feed, no clock, no text. Keep original warm pale-brown outline and cream/salmon colors. Fully transparent alpha outside the birds; remove loose red/yellow colored flecks. No changes to the bird identities.
prompts.walkPaletteCorrection:
Use case: precise-object-edit / palette correction ONLY.
Image1 is the finished 4x3 12-frame walking chicken atlas. Keep every silhouette, exact foot pose, location, frame layout, outline WIDTH and animation phase unchanged. The alternating feet must stay as they are.
Image2 is the approved original chicken and the authoritative color reference. Image1 has become too orange and its outline too dark after editing. Correct its colors to match image2, without changing any shapes.
Required target palette in actual sRGB pixel colors: main warm outline approximately RGB(168,120,88) / #a87858, not dark red-brown; inside wing lines approximately #c49a77. Cream body near #fff9ed with gentle pale cream shading #f5e4c9; comb soft light salmon #f6a88d; golden feet and beak #f3cf72. One eye in the same warm brown. No strong gradient, no saturated red, no dark black outline. Match image2 exactly, don't add details or texture.
Transparency: outside chicken silhouettes must be genuinely fully transparent. Remove all floating red and yellow speckles and all detached colored haze around the sprites. Do not replace with white, black or checkerboard; no shadows. Preserve proper anti-aliased silhouette edges.
Return the same 4 columns x 3 rows with twelve distinct existing poses. No labels, no borders, no UI.
